english.title: Enter / leave a tram on the Croydon Tramlink system Improperly
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[entered]_
(B)_[left]_

a tram at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) on the Croydon Tramlink system

(C)_[other than by proper use of a tram door, namely **(..SPECIFY THE MANNER OF ENTRY / LEAVING..)]_
(D)_[other than at a tramstop when the tram had come to a halt, namely **(..SPECIFY THE MANNER OF ENTRY / LEAVING..)]_
(E)_[when the door closing sound was sounding]_
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 11(5) and 26 of the Croydon Tramlink Byelaws made under section 46 of the Croydon Tramlink Act 1994.
english.pointstoprove:
date and place
entered / left / a tram on the Croydon Tramlink system
other than by proper use of a tram door OR
other than at a tramstop when the tram had come to a halt OR
when the door closing sound was sounding.
